description: PROGRESSIVE FINETUNING WITH DATA REHEARSAL: ANRI → DIBCO. Uses rehearsal dataset (50% Base + 30% DIBCO + 20% ANRI) to prevent catastrophic forgetting while adapting to DIBCO. Strategy: (1) Pretrained from ANRI best model (ckpt-115, Base 30.69 dB, ANRI 33.02 dB), (2) NO layer freezing, (3) Proven LR 5e-6/1e-5, (4) Rehearsal dataset with ALL 3 domains (Base 537 + DIBCO 322 + ANRI 214 = 1073 samples), (5) TRIPLE validation (Base + ANRI + DIBCO), (6) Red line safety: Base ≥27 dB, ANRI ≥30 dB, DIBCO ≥27 dB, (7) Early stopping patience 2. Goal: Achieve DIBCO performance (28-30 dB) while maintaining Base (~30.5 dB) and ANRI (~32 dB) via data rehearsal.

dataset_composition.note: Data rehearsal prevents catastrophic forgetting by including ANRI samples during DIBCO finetuning

progressive_finetuning_strategy.approach: Sequential domain adaptation WITH DATA REHEARSAL
progressive_finetuning_strategy.transfer_learning: ANRI knowledge preserved via rehearsal samples
progressive_finetuning_strategy.improvement_over_v4: v4 failed with 0% ANRI (catastrophic forgetting -3.37 dB), v1 uses 20% ANRI rehearsal

safety.warnings: Base 28.5 dB, ANRI 31.5 dB, DIBCO 28.5 dB

strategy.early_stopping: patience=3 (allow more exploration than v4 patience=2)

expected_outcome.dibco_psnr: 28-30 dB (achievable with rehearsal, better than v4's 14.84 dB)
expected_outcome.anri_psnr: 31.5-32.5 dB (preserved via 20% rehearsal, better than v4's catastrophic 29.65 dB)
expected_outcome.best_epoch: 6-10 (more epochs needed due to multi-domain optimization)
expected_outcome.training_time: ~90-120 minutes (10 epochs × 9-12 min, slower due to 3-domain balancing)
expected_outcome.emergency_stop_risk: LOW - rehearsal dataset includes all 3 domains

improvements_from_v4: Data rehearsal with 20% ANRI samples (v4 had 0% → catastrophic forgetting)
Expected ANRI PSNR ~32 dB (v4 catastrophic 29.65 dB, -3.37 dB drop)
Expected DIBCO PSNR ~28-30 dB (v4 failed at 14.84 dB)
Red line safety for all 3 domains (prevent catastrophic forgetting)
No emergency stop expected (all domains represented in training)
lessons_from_v4: Progressive finetuning WITHOUT rehearsal = guaranteed catastrophic forgetting
1 epoch without ANRI data = -3.37 dB ANRI drop (v4 result)
Pretrained weights alone DON'T preserve performance without gradient signals
Data rehearsal is MANDATORY for continual learning
This config implements correct multi-domain learning approach
